items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Greg McRitchie(?) was the conductor, and I did that for about I guess three years.

ctx.x: Well, I refused to get bogged down. I managed to do record dates still, and... You know, I'd sandwich them in between the times I had to be on the studio, at the studio. Almost at the same time I did a thing that's just come back on, Rich Little is the host -- You Asked For It. I did that. Greg McRitchie(?) was the conductor, and I did that for about I guess three years. Meanwhile I was doing things with Nelson Riddle and Billy May, and even I did a lot of stuff with Lawrence Welk, a lot of polka albums playing…
Well, a lot of good musicians have worked with Lawrence Welk.
